content.text: The first McpFn gate exposed a real porting issue: regenerating `package-lock.json` floated the MCP SDK from the source snapshot’s 1.25.2 to 1.30.0, whose stateless transport rejects a test pattern this code relies on. I’m pinning the manifest dependency to the known source version so the PR is reproducible instead of depending on an accidental old lockfile.
